headline: BATON reports gains from balancing feedback attribution and trajectory mass in agent RL
summary: A September 2026 preprint introduces BATON, which combines Bayesian Feedback Attribution within trajectories with equal-mass aggregation across trajectories. On Qwen2.5-Instruct models, the authors report gains over matched GRPO and GiGPO variants on ALFWorld, WebShop and seven-dataset search-augmented QA; a 2×2 ablation reports gains from each component separately. For example, ALFWorld success with Qwen2.5-1.5B rises from 72.9% to 85.6% for GRPO and from 86.8% to 94.1% for GiGPO. These are paper-reported results, not independently reproduced. The authors explicitly say the feedback likelihood measures model-based compatibility rather than causal effects of counterfactual actions.
